scoring_formula.setup_friction: 100 - (10 × num_commands) - (15 if api_key_required) + (20 if docker) + (30 if one_line_install). Clamp 0-100.
scoring_formula.time_to_first_run: 100 if one_line + docker. 80 docker only. 60 if quickstart claro mas precisa configurar. 40 if pip/npm + N steps. 20 if precisa build do source.
scoring_formula.docs_onboarding_quality: 50 base + 15 if separate docs site + 10 if examples folder + 10 if video + 15 if API ref docs.
